title: Novel mixed-valent Co(II)2Co(III)4Ln(III)4 aggregates with ligands derived from tris-(hydroxymethyl)aminomethane (Tris)

material_class.structural_family: decanuclear mixed-valent CoII2CoIII4LnIII4 Tris coordination cluster

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Co(OAc)2·4H2O (498 mg, 2 mmol), Y(NO3)3·6H2O (913 mg, 2 mmol) and trisH3 (242 mg, 2 mmol) were dissolved in 20 mL methanol. After stirring at about 50 °C for about 10 minutes, triethylamine (101 mg, 1 mmol) in 1 mL methanol was added to the peach-red mixture. Heating was continued for about 10 minutes and the mixture was stirred for another 20 minutes. The dark violet solution was cooled, filtered and layered with n-hexane. Dark violet crystals formed after about one week.
synthesis.time: about 10 min stirring, about 10 min further heating, 20 min stirring, about one week crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction followed by layering with n-hexane
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered, and layered with n-hexane; dark violet crystals after about one week

properties.summary: Diamagnetic Y(III) isolates the Co(II) dimer. χT falls from 5.89 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to a minimum of 5.05 cm3 K mol−1 at 30 K (spin–orbit coupling), then rises, consistent with weak ferromagnetic Co(II)–Co(II) coupling through a Co–O–Co angle of 93.8°, before dropping to 5.65 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization at 5 T is 4.29 μB and does not saturate by 7 T. No ac out-of-phase signal was observed in zero dc field.

properties.summary: χT at 300 K (35.48 cm3 K mol−1) is close to the spin-only expectation (35.25). It decreases to 30.86 cm3 K mol−1 near 10 K and to 23.93 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. After subtracting the Y analogue, the adjusted data indicate antiferromagnetic Co(II)–Gd(III) coupling; a Curie–Weiss fit above 20 K gives C = 26.4 cm3 K mol−1 and θ = −0.75 K. Magnetization does not saturate at 7 T. No ac out-of-phase signal was observed in zero dc field.

properties.summary: χT at 300 K is 60.36 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 60.43), decreases to 49.61 near 10 K and a minimum of 48.75 cm3 K mol−1 at 3 K, then rises slightly to 51.63 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Adjusted Curie–Weiss parameters above 20 K are C = 47.6 cm3 K mol−1 and θ = −1.06 K. Magnetization does not saturate at 7 T. Frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility below 10 K in zero dc field indicates slow relaxation and SMM behaviour, attributed to Dy(III) anisotropy.
